headline:

intro: SANJU X DEV builds professional digital experiences for individuals, businesses and organizations.
about: SANJU X DEV is a web development and digital solutions business. We bring design and engineering together to create clear, engaging experiences for businesses and their customers.

services.name: Personal Portfolio
services.description: Show your skills, projects, achievements and experience in a modern personal website.
services.example: Developer portfolios, design showcases, executive resumes, creator brands.
services.items: Skills, projects, resume download, contact pathways

services.name: Blog / Content Website
services.description: Share articles, stories, news and regular updates with an easy publishing workflow.
services.example: Industry blogs, editorial magazines, news portals, thought-leadership platforms.
services.items: Articles, categories, search, admin publishing area

services.name: Business Website
services.description: Help customers learn about your business, build credibility and contact you easily.
services.example: Corporate companies, local service providers, professional consultancies, clinics.
services.items: Business information, services, gallery, WhatsApp, map location

services.name: Agency Website
services.description: Showcase your agency, services, team members, client case studies and completed work.
services.example: Design studios, marketing firms, software development agencies, production houses.
services.items: Agency services, team profiles, case studies, client enquiry forms

services.name: E-Commerce Website
services.description: Sell products and receive online orders with shopping carts, checkout and secure payments.
services.example: Fashion boutiques, electronic shops, digital downloads, specialty merchandise.
services.items: Product catalogue, shopping cart, checkout, payments, customer login, order tracking

services.name: Restaurant / Food Business Website
services.description: Show your food menu, opening hours, dining location, table bookings and ordering options.
services.example: Cafes, dining restaurants, cloud kitchens, bakeries, food trucks.
services.items: Food menu, online ordering, table booking, location, opening hours, WhatsApp

services.name: Shop / Store Website
services.description: Show products, seasonal offers, store location, and simple contact or ordering information.
services.example: Local retail shops, jewelry stores, grocery outlets, home decor showrooms.
services.items: Product gallery, product categories, WhatsApp ordering, payments, reviews

services.name: Educational Website
services.description: Create a website for a school, college, tuition institute, online course or learning service.
services.example: Schools, coaching centers, online academies, individual tutors, skill workshops.
services.items: Course info, about school/teacher, enrolment form, gallery, notice board

services.name: Booking Website
services.description: Let customers request or schedule appointments, consultations and service slots online.
services.example: Salons, dental clinics, fitness trainers, photography sessions, consultations.
services.items: Service catalog, calendar booking, working hours, WhatsApp, reviews

services.name: Custom Website
services.description: Build something completely tailored to your unique concept, workflow and requirements.
services.example: Community portals, interactive utilities, web apps, member directories, custom tools.
services.items: Custom pages, interactive forms, database integration, tailored workflows

projects.name: StarX Live — Official Website
projects.headline: A live identity. A considered digital stage.
projects.summary: An entertainment website connecting artists, performances and enquiries.
projects.story: A rich collection of band content is organized around clear navigation. Artist profiles, performance media and contact pathways offer several useful ways to explore.
projects.note: Public pages inspected. Booking fulfilment was not tested. The live crew page identifies Sanjay as Digital Media & Creative Director, managing the website and digital presence.

projects.name: TicketX
projects.headline: From discovery to the next show.
projects.summary: Cinema and event discovery organized around locations, listings and showtimes.
projects.story: Movie listings, theatre directories, language browsing and event discovery connect to showtime and account entry points in a single public interface.
projects.note: Public interfaces inspected. Payment, seat fulfilment and authenticated booking records were not tested.

projects.name: StarX Connect — Digital Card
projects.headline: One link. Every important connection.
projects.summary: A compact branded contact experience for official channels and direct actions.
projects.story: The digital card collects the official website and social channels alongside call, email, WhatsApp, location and save-contact controls. Its focused presentation demonstrates the value of one shareable destination.
projects.note: Visible controls inspected. External messages were not sent.

projects.name: AudioX
projects.headline: Utility, with a clear point of focus.
projects.summary: An audio utility interface with focused input and dedicated queue and download areas.
projects.story: AudioX presents a media URL analysis workflow for content the visitor owns or is permitted to download. Its primary action is separated from queue, download and settings navigation.
features: Media URL input and Analyze action
projects.note: Interface inspected. Conversion and completed downloads were not tested.

projects.name: Yuva Shakti Youth Satulur — Lucky Draw
projects.headline: A community event, clearly connected.
projects.summary: Event information, participant details and coupon-verification entry points.
projects.story: The public experience brings event information, a quantity selector, participant form, pass preview and coupon lookup into a guided page. This case study focuses on interface design and information architecture.
features: Coupon verification and support entry points
projects.note: Public interface inspected only. Purchases, payment verification and draw outcomes were not tested or endorsed.

faqs.a: Business websites, e-commerce, UI/UX, custom applications, interactive experiences and redesigns.
Explore StarX Live, TicketX, StarX Connect, AudioX and Yuva Shakti in Our Work. Each has a case study and live link.

faqs.q: How much does a website cost?
faqs.a: Pricing depends on scope, integrations and content. Share a brief for a tailored discussion. We confirm timelines after understanding the work.
